method.criterion: CPU prepare primary; UI callback-to-ready regression tolerance 10% after considering A/A variation. Small sample medians/raw values only; no tail or significance claim.
method.environment: Private Windows desktop, other user/session load unmanaged, 1280x900, max_fps 60
method.order: One warmup per version, four A/A pairs, twelve alternating A/B pairs, final ON diagnostic per version. Native undo and derived settling between every observation. No cache reset, no cold claim; real PBR inputs identical.
method.scope: Real UI text preview callback and later rendered frame; actual apply callback to all road editor nodes/picking bodies, pending groups zero, two physics frames and rendered frame. No ghost mesh in this panel; not gameplay traversal, photon latency or GPU duration.
